summary: Independent review of the Lys-C SDRF (207 RAW, 414 SILAC light/heavy rows) found no blocking or important issues; spec, ontology, file mapping, design and RAW-derived technical values were re-derived from primary sources.

reviewer_context.context: fresh subagent (review-lysc-3) without producer transcript; earlier review-* dirs not read; producer manifest treated as untrusted and re-checked against PRIDE, PMC8628316, mzid and RAW headers fetched by the reviewer

spec_compliance.evidence: Columns compared with sdrf-tools contract -t ms-proteomics@1.1.0 -t vertebrates@1.1.0 (released latest in templates.yaml): all required columns present, order correct, factor value last, 38 cells in every row, reserved words only where allow_* permits (cell type, sex, factor value[disease] -> disease allows not applicable). Repeated comment[sdrf template] and comment[modification parameters] are multiple-cardinality. (source name, assay name, comment[label]) unique for all 414 rows.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Reviewer queried OLS4 for all 18 accessions: MS:1001910 Orbitrap Elite, MS:1001309 Lys-C, MS:1000422 beam-type collision-induced dissociation, MS:1000484 orbitrap, PRIDE:0000627/0000564/0000608/0000599/0000325/0000326, UNIMOD:4/35/188/1, MONDO:0005180, PATO:0000461, EFO:0001272, UBERON:0001891; labels match exactly, none obsolete. sdrf-tools check: 17/17 verified, 0 UNIMOD swaps.

source_evidence.evidence: PMC8628316 (title/PMID 34061533 verified): one mouse per arm ('one for each'), SILAM C57BL/6J 13C6-Lys pool mixed into lysates, PFF/PBS digested with LysC only, A53T LysC flow-through series, DTT/IAA, HCD, Orbitrap MS2, 10 ppm/0.02 Da, 24 hpH fractions, B6C3F2 founders crossed to B6, sex unreported. Mouse_SILAM_PFF_rep1.mzid streamed: Enzyme LysC; UNIMOD:188/4/35 and Acetyl UNIMOD:1 on 972 peptides all starting with M with pre='-' (protein N-term). RAW headers (bytes 0-4 MB) of 10 files spanning all 4 arms, rep1/rep2 and suffixed re-acquisitions (A53T_control_rep1_LysC_f09a, A53T_control_rep2_LysC_F10, A53T_mutant_rep1_LysC_f17, A53T_mutant_rep2_LysC_F03, PBS_rep1_F19c, PBS_rep2_F24b, PFF_rep1_F05, PFF_rep1_F21b, PFF_rep2_F08b, PFF_rep2_F12_b): all 'Orbitrap Elite MS', Activation Type HCD; rep1 NCE 32.0 + FTMS o(300.0-1700.0) (2014 methods), rep2 NCE 35.0 + o(350.0-1700.0) (method 120m_120_30_8HCD_35_long_column_011216, 2016) - every sampled row matches the SDRF.

file_mapping.evidence: Fresh PRIDE v3 files/all: 320 entries, projectAccessions={PXD015293}, 303 RAW. Lys-C SDRF holds 207 distinct RAW (each on exactly one light + one heavy row), trypsin sibling 96; overlap 0, missing 0, unmatched 0, union = 303. Only vendor .raw in comment[data file]; assay name = file stem.

design_consistency.evidence: 4 light sources (PFF 51, PBS 60, AAV1-tTA 48, AAV1-GFP 48 rows) + 4 per-mixture SILAM heavy sources; light/heavy pairs agree on assay, fraction, technical replicate, CE and scan range; heavy rows pooled/C57BL/6J/normal with factor not applicable; light factor = characteristics[disease]. Coordinate (source, biological replicate, technical replicate, fraction) unique. Fractions 1-24 from file names; rep1->techrep 1, rep2->2, re-acquisitions rep+2n. Factor PD vs normal matches the two compared contrasts.

omission_safety.evidence: No value asserts more than the sources: sex left not available (paper 'male and female'), strain substrain not upgraded to C57BL/6J for Jackson PFF mice, ventral midbrain generalised to midbrain rather than an unsupported narrower term, pooled count not invented, Acetyl added only from deposited search output. Paper's stale NCE 32 / m/z 350-1550 correctly overridden by RAW for rep2.

deterministic_validation.evidence: Reviewer ran (flock) parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics: exit 0 'Everything seems to be fine'; -t vertebrates: exit 0, 3 warnings (strain free text not in NCBITaxon); union -t ms-proteomics -t vertebrates: exit 0, same warnings. sdrf-tools check exit 0 CLEAN; sdrf-tools score 100/100.

findings.message: parse_sdrf warns that C57BL/6J, C57BL/6 and 'B6C3F2 x C57BL/6' are not NCBITaxon terms.
findings.evidence: Template declares strain or breed as free text; warning is expected and non-blocking.

findings.message: Paper dissected ventral midbrain; SDRF records parent UBERON midbrain.
findings.evidence: No exact UBERON term; generalisation is conservative and documented.

findings.message: Re-acquisition-as-technical-replicate scheme is the producer's interpretation; the deposit does not document whether suffixed files are re-injections.
findings.evidence: RAW dates differ (e.g. PFF_rep1_F05 11/8/2014 vs F21b 12/11/2014), consistent with re-injection; documented in manifest limitations.

findings.message: Transgene/injection arm (PFF, PBS, AAV1-tTA, AAV1-GFP; TetP-hA53T) is carried only in source name; no characteristics[treatment]/genotype column.
findings.evidence: Neither column is required; treatment needs an NCIT/EFO term which the producer could not find.
